proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ _ f
  have hc : ((∑ ψ : AddChar G ℂ, Complex.normSq (∑ y, f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ y)) : ℝ) : ℂ) = (((Fintype.card G : ℝ) * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    push_cast
    have e : ∀ ψ : AddChar G ℂ, ((Complex.normSq (∑ y, f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ y)) : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∑ y, ∑ z, f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (f z) * ψ (z - y) := by
      intro ψ
      rw [← Complex.mul_conj, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_))
      rw [map_mul, Complex.conj_conj, sub_eq_add_neg, AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, AddChar.map_neg_eq_conj]
      ring
    simp only [e]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun y _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have e2 : ∀ z : G, ∑ ψ : AddChar G ℂ, f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (f z) * ψ (z - y) = f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (f z) * (if z = y then (Fintype.card G : ℂ) else 0) := by
      intro z
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, AddChar.sum_apply_eq_ite]
      simp [sub_eq_zero]
    simp only [e2, mul_ite, mul_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ y]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    rw [Complex.mul_conj]
    ring
  exact_mod_cast hc
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] (f : G → ℂ), ∑ ψ : AddChar G ℂ, Complex.normSq (∑ y, f y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (ψ y)) = (Fintype.card G : ℝ) * ∑ x, Complex.normSq (f x)
